If you can provide any of the above, procurement can proceed to clear the PO gate. If you expect a delay >48 hours, please confirm and we can discuss a provisional PO path (one-time limited PO) subject to legal approval.

For transparency I've looped in Ben from Sales for the provisioning timing and Karthik from Procurement for the PO steps.
